notes.title: Tech Update: 7.01.2021 | Save file issue has been fixed!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24296578/0549db87c46f87641ded3bd1b36c85b5b7acbd10.jpg[/img]

Hi there, Detectives!

Good news! We've just updated the game with a small but important fix! It's a[b] fix for the issue that prevented the players from loading the game from a save slot[/b]. The update is live now.

In case of further problems after the patch, please let us know [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/461950/discussions/0/3016815718815231684/]here[/url]. Thank you.

We wish you all the best in 2021, stay safe!

Cheers,
[i]11 bit studios & Pixel Crow[/i]

notes.title: Beat Cop arrives on Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, and PlayStation 4!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32989971/f6cb5aae6bd0915b5497ef9b3479180612b7301b.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]We are happy to announce that Beat Cop is available now on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, and Xbox One.[/b][/h1] 

For the average price of a dozen donuts ($14.99 / €14.99), you can fill the shoes of disgraced detective Jack Kelly on his road to redemption after being framed for murder.

Patrolling the gritty streets of 1980's Brooklyn is no cake walk, and when you're a police officer who has been implicated for a murder you didn't commit, it's even harder. Jack Kelly's on a mission to clear his name in this pixel perfect homage to the cop shows of days gone by, and he can't do it without your help.

[b]Watch the release trailer here:[/b]
https://youtu.be/LXVsCIgX-ow
Solve puzzling problems on the roughest of streets, help the local community, deal with dangerous mobsters and gangsters, be the good cop or take the odd bribe on the side, and finally, solve the mystery of a murder you’ve been framed for.

[h1][b]Features:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Retro pixel art experience with a non-linear story and multiple endings
[*] The pure essence of ‘80s cop shows
[*]Mature *ahem* humor
[*] Laying down the law, one ticket at a time
[/list]

Originally developed for PC by the indie team at Pixel Crow and published by 11 bit studios, Beat Cop: Console Edition has been brought to life by the sweet, huggable team at Crunching Koalas.

More at:
https://www.facebook.com/beatcopgame
http://beatcopgame.com/
https://twitter.com/pxcrow
https://twitter.com/11bitstudios

Cheers!
11 bit studios

notes.title: Tower 57 is OUT!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24296578/5966ace381e034be2bf636b9c7aac5066cac246a.gif[/img]

Hi there, everyone!

If you enjoyed Beat Cop, you may enjoy another pixel retro-inspired game that we've just released: Tower 57!

[h1][b]What is Tower 57?[/b][/h1]
Tower 57 is a TOP-DOWN TWIN STICK SHOOTER with 16-bit inspired pixel art, destructible environments and heavy focus on CO-OP. It is also a modern take on what made AMIGA games so great back in the days.

[h1][b]Here's Tower 57's launch trailer, with a cool, jazzy tune:[/b][/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x7gdwGHMEgs
[h1][b]You can grab the game here:[/b][/h1]
http://store.steampowered.com/app/530950/Tower_57/
[h1][b]Game features:[/b][/h1][list]
[*][b]Fast-paced Arcade Gameplay[/b] - shoot everything that moves and don’t get killed in the process.
[*][b]Unique Weapons and Characters[/b] - choose from a roster of six particular characters with different skillsets, number of upgradable weapons and gadgets.
[*][b]Cooperation[/b] - Tower 57's main campaign is designed for both, single player & local/online CO-OP.
[*][b]Dieselpunk World[/b] - times of randomly generated levels are gone - everything in Tower 57 is carefully designed and pixel-crafted with the highest attention to detail.
[*][b]Destructible Environment[/b] - everything, from debris and shell casings to bloody footprints, will mark your destructive trail through the Tower.
[*][b]LOTS of Enemies[/b] - and you'd better learn their vulnerabilities if you don't want to end up dead very quick.
[*][b]DINOSAURS![/b] - yup, we have dinosaurs.[/list]
[b]Now GO and SPREAD THE MAYHEM![/b]

notes.title: Beat Cop Update 1.1.747
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24296578/cc6027242b310e999c4b531d07a028cdabc85c24.gif[/img]

Hi there, everyone!

We have just updated Beat Cop to version [b]1.1.747[/b]. 

[h1][b]Here's the list of changes:[/b][/h1][list]
[*]Korean language is now available in game!
[*]by popular demand we've added option to skip dialogues with space bar
[*]we've added Steam Cloud support (Windows only for now)
[*]some minor bug fixes and polishes[/list]
Besides that, we've also launched a special [b]sale for Beat Cop - you can grab it 60% OFF![/b] 
Sale starts on 13.11.2017 at 10:00 am PST and ends on 20.11.2017 at 10:00 am PST.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/461950/Beat_Cop/
Have a good one, donut lovers!

notes.title: Update! New languages and fixes!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24296578/1a6b5433960794ca0a2d03bc32fef44ca2095230.png[/img]

[h1]Hey there, everyone![/h1]

[b]It's update time[/b]! We know that you've been waiting for new languages to be available in game - and we are sorry that we couldn't provide them on the release they. But they're finally here alongside some bug fixes!

[b]List of changes[/b]:[list]
[*][b]Language support[/b] - enjoy Beat Cop in three more languages: [b]Spanish, Russian and Brazilian Portuguese[/b]!
[*][b]Day 21 bug[/b] - we resolved the potential conflict that appeared during few of game's endings on Day 21; now you should be able to finish Beat Cop with no issues (again)
[*]some minor stability and text-related tweaks
[/list]
[b]Also, remember to to update your game to the newest version![/b]

Yes, [b]we plan to add more languages in the near future and yes, we're still collecting feedback[/b] from you. If something is wrong with your game - just describe it in "Tech Stuff" section on Steam Discussions. 

Thank you for playing Beat Cop! Have a good one!​

notes.title: New update 1.0.585 available now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

we've just posted a fresh [b]update[/b]. We're still working hard on improving the game based on your feedback. This time we focused on:
[list]
 [*]Fixing an issue with the "time passed" screen. Now it appears and ... disappears, so it should be just fine :]
 [*]Fixing a problem making it hard to talk to the priest NPC in day 20.
 [*]German font and layout improvements.
 [*]Sound setting should now be saved properly.
 [*]Starting disclaimer may now be skipped.
 [*]Minor VSync fixes.
 [*]Plenty of minor tweaks here and there.
[/list]
Thank for playing and thanks for sharing your feedback!

notes.title: Beat Cop is available now!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24296578/882025760a083f6bb4611554a5202a2b3280108e.png[/img]

[b]Have you ever dreamed of being one of the heroes of cop movies?[/b] Of course you did, like we all. Now you have a chance! Be sexier than Sonny Crocket and tougher than Dirty Harry. And if witty comebacks won’t work, you can always do some old school ass kicking.[b] It’s 80’s after all![/b]

[h1]All units respond, [b]BEAT COP is available now for $14.99 on[/b]:[/h1][list]
[*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/461950/]Steam Store [/url]
[*][url=https://www.humblebundle.com/store/beat-cop]Humble Store[/url]
[*][url=https://www.gog.com/game/beat_cop]GOG[/url][/list]

Official launch trailer:
https://youtu.be/ldbkBDzC2m4
[b]Beat Cop is a mixture of adventure/point&click/time-management game[/b] in retro aesthetics, which allows you to experience humorous and tense 80s police dramedy.

[b]Beat Cop is developed by Pixel Crow and published by 11 bit studios[/b].

---

[b]Day 1 patch[/b] - list of changes:[list]
[*]German language added
[*]Balance tweaks (character speeds, action speeds, quests counters)
[*]Achievements added
[*]Additional sound effects and music tracks added
[*]Minor bugfixes[/list]
